_comment: Canonical registration of the VALIDATE PRODUCER DEFINITION -- which exact whole-file map is currently allowed to mint a landing-authorizing receipt. `registered` is the primary definition; one exact transition for Hermit PR #2070 is staged. Colocated with qualifying-receipt.json / rebase-base-floors.json. Task bind-receipt-to-producer-definition-not-only-the-gate-file.
_why: hermit #1579 bound the GATE FILE: the run's own .github/workflows/merge-gate.yml blob must equal vars.MERGE_GATE_V4_BLOB. It did NOT bind the PRODUCER. A PR could therefore present a CURRENT gate file while its receipt had been minted by an OLDER validate.sh -- i.e. by an older, weaker definition of what 'validated' means. That is the #231 shape (signal not bound to fact) applied to the producer instead of the consumer. This file is the producer-side half, symmetric with MERGE_GATE_V4_BLOB.
_not_hypothetical: Measured 2026-08-06: validate.sh blob was 9a9c31ce24abaa764089af7c4cafc820709c4c77 at hermit f89c69766371806d3c9b2c3003531df2d59d6118 and 836a070e5e02017ae232e243904fb033a5c45b17 at 4c70658e785834737cbe1524f77330c781a6f5ea -- the producer definition changed within 8 commits on main in a single day, while ci-portable.yml did not move. A receipt minted at the older head was produced by a different definition than the current one.
_rotation_2026_08_08: Audited rrnewton/hermit main b6051b1cd1402526c76ea768167c875188144328: it resolves validate.sh to 349f8c0bae065597708019005180d2872d9c90b2 and ci-portable.yml to ef7cdc0211ebaeafcaba4286cb2374a80ab9f3fb. This versioned primary predates direct test-harness binding. It remains qualifying as legacy-selected-paths evidence and must never be reported as complete producer coverage.
_rotation_2026_08_09: Owner-authorized Rust production cutover landed as rrnewton/hermit 92aaed5d09dd44ae4fb330a99c7adf28c1fc0cae (PR #1996). The selected paths bound the direct Rust driver, its temporary exec-only shim, and the portable workflow at that exact commit. PR #1998 then removed the shim at main commit 93575493f406fb6115134b95d54d4a4650214a07; the current definition binds only the sole Rust driver and portable workflow. Coverage remains legacy-selected-paths rather than falsely claiming those two files cover every transitive Rust module, manifest, and corpus.
_rotation_2026_08_09_receipt_authority: The stale PR #2008 transition named historical head d21bce4e even though that open PR moved on; it was replaced rather than promoted. PR #2016 restores canonical ledger publication and binds both changed Rust implementation modules in addition to the driver and portable workflow, so an unchanged front file cannot conceal receipt/history producer drift.
_rotation_2026_08_09_validate_runtime: PR #2023 (linear successor to stale-base #2021) changes the Rust driver's full-plan scheduling while preserving the complete node denominator: portable and privileged lanes fuse, byte-identical manifest/pin authorities alias to observed preflight gates, and privileged checks fan out from asserted fat-build artifacts. The candidate binds that exact driver blob before its performance receipt can qualify.
_rotation_2026_08_10_canonical_ledger: PR #2012 removes the Rust driver's discovered, environment-selected, and checkout-local ledger paths. Its exact candidate was staged, but the PR produced a genuine non-pass verdict while blocked on the independently proven shared-binary relink race. The candidate was replaced rather than promoted or extended; #2012 cannot mint a qualifying receipt until its exact map is staged again after that blocker clears.
_rotation_2026_08_10_rr_evidence: PR #2070 refuses record/replay compatibility rows without an evidence-bearing machine verdict. It changes both scripts/validate.rs and the transitive scripts/lib/validate_plan.rs module, so the complete transition adds validate_plan.rs explicitly rather than pretending the old four-path map covers it. This candidate does not contain or imply PR #2012's canonical-ledger changes.
_transition_protocol: A candidate is accepted only as one exact whole map before expires_at; consumers never union fields across primary/candidate. finalize_after is an earliest lifecycle-review time, not merge evidence or landing authority. Promotion requires fresh proof of the PR's dereferenced merge commit on fetched Hermit main and that main resolves to the candidate map; rebase merge does not preserve PR-head ancestry. At every promotion the outgoing primary becomes legacy. A complete primary that was unbounded while current is narrowed to its registered_at replay when superseded, so the same old map cannot authorize a later commit; this keeps complete-to-complete rotations repeatable and fail-closed.
_generalises_the_anchor: The pre-anchor rule (a PR head must descend from hermit bfb0a9ef, else it runs its own older validate.sh) is a SINGLE-COMMIT ANCHOR: it goes stale every time the producer changes and must be hand-advanced. This registration is its hash-valued generalisation, exactly as #1579 generalised the gate-file case.
_semantics: EXACT WHOLE-MAP EQUALITY, fail closed. A qualifying receipt MUST carry producer.definition whose key set and blob values equal one complete current/candidate map, or equal a legacy map at one of that record's explicit valid_commits, exactly. A receipt with no producer block, a missing file, an undeclared extra file, a crossed map, a legacy map at another commit, or any differing blob is REFUSED. Candidate keys may exceed primary keys only by the exact explicit transition.added_paths set; no removals or implicit drift are allowed, and maps are never field-unioned. Every verdict carries coverage_status plus the exact paths and any commit bound. An unreadable or malformed registration, legacy record, or transition is a DEPLOY DEFECT (exit 2), never a lenient fallback. Expiry removes only the candidate; the b605 primary remains qualifying only at its explicitly registered commit.
_advancing_this: Stage a producer change by adding one strictly shaped transition without changing `registered`. Derive every candidate SHA and blob from the selected head; never copy values from a superseded PR. After that exact head lands, freshly prove target-main containment and resolve its producer blobs before promoting the candidate to `registered`, advancing `registered_at`, and deleting `transition`. A timestamp never authorizes promotion. If the candidate does not land before expiry, remove or replace the transition; never extend it implicitly.
_rotation_2026_08_10: Promoted at hermit main 2b38d8e629ee582db6a59f340b1a3c8980fd85c5. Commits a9262ac2 and 2b38d8e6 add the single apt package `ncat` to three ci-portable matrix jobs, moving that file's blob 34beade4840a -> c0de07a73f14 while scripts/validate.rs and both validate_*.rs stay byte-identical -- nothing about how validation is produced changed. Because the map is whole-map exact and fail-closed, that one-word dependency edit refused EVERY receipt at main, including a genuine full PASS at this exact commit, leaving main with no landing authority. Proved fresh before promoting: 2b38d8e6 is the fetched main tip, b5a4748e is its ancestor, and main resolves all four registered paths to the new map. Any concurrently staged candidate is keyed to its own unlanded head and is preserved untouched; this advances the primary to the LANDED state only.
_rotation_2026_08_10_newest_tests_misc: Promoted at hermit main 9d1a73b5677f0dd48f56955c2ae270ba74dde0a9. That commit ('ci: select the newest tests_misc binary instead of requiring exactly one') moves scripts/validate.rs df03defdc9d0 -> 00e56c0d7e0d; the other three registered paths are byte-identical. It landed WITHOUT a staged producer transition, so from that tip onward every local receipt resolved a validate.rs blob present in neither the primary map nor the pending PR-2012 candidate and was refused as unregistered-or-unresolvable -- blocking the entire local-receipt landing path for every PR based on main, not just one. Reviewed before promoting rather than rubber-stamped: the change is a STRENGTHENING. The old node asserted `test "$count" -eq 1` over target/debug/deps/tests_misc-*, which cargo never prunes, so it could never pass in a working tree that had accumulated binaries (measured 9 in the owner's checkout vs 1 in a clean slot) -- agents in clean clones saw green while the owner saw a red he had never seen pass. It selects the newest by mtime rather than relaxing to -ge 1, deliberately, because the CPUID node EXECUTES its selection and 'any one of nine' would silently test a stale artifact. It also closes a pre-existing hole where `&&` bound only to an assignment, so the node could pass with target/debug/hermit missing. Zero candidates still fails. Proved fresh before promoting: 9d1a73b5 is the fetched main tip, 2b38d8e6 is its ancestor, and main resolves all four paths to the new map. The PR-2012 candidate is keyed to its own unlanded head and is preserved untouched.
_rotation_2026_08_10_immutable_artifact_: Promoted at hermit main f4c85fa24d10f4e58c254fcd74294d306d230138 after exact-map review. PR #2080 changed scripts/validate.rs to preserve the scheduler-owned deadline and retain per-node timeout evidence; PR #2073 changed ci-portable.yml to consume the dependency-produced immutable Hermit binary. The subsequent f4c85fa24 commit only adds the owner's tracked validate.sh entrypoint and leaves all four registered blobs byte-identical to merge commit 6cbed206e9b5823e8af629619c62a4a82ae2d517. The 10:36 owner run at 6cbed206 completed 56/56 gates, all 19 planned test nodes, and 873 tests with zero failures, skips, absent nodes, or zero-execution nodes, but the exception-adjusted authority correctly refused its exact unregistered map. This rotation registers only the four resolved blobs; it does not weaken qualification or pattern-match future producers. Proved before promotion: the canonical Hermit checkout and origin/main both resolve to f4c85fa24, the exact four-file map below resolves there, and the independent PR-2070 candidate is preserved unchanged.
_rotation_2026_08_10_validate_reminder_a: Promoted at hermit main d810b399e6df76cd647c4cef0a78eeb80efd6f26 after the entrypoint-audit repair moved the exact scripts/validate.rs blob. The implementation change is documentation-only inside the registered Rust driver: it states that the repository-root validate.sh file is an audited reminder alias with no independent behavior. The same commit strengthens ci/test_harness.sh to accept only the exact three-line executable alias and to reject extra wrapper behavior. Exact whole-map equality correctly refused d810b399 until this rotation even though the other three registered blobs were unchanged. Qualification remains byte-identical; this update changes only the exact registered producer identity and version-bounds the outgoing f4c85fa24 map. The independent PR-2070 candidate is preserved unchanged.
